main_subject.detail: Premium beauty poster with header 'PAULA'S CHOICE SKINCARE' and giant Vietnamese headline 'SIEU SALE CUOI THANG QUA TANG NGAP TRAN'. A silver rounded info bar lists 'Voucher 1 TRIEU DONG', 'Uu dai 50%', and 'Qua tang 5 TRIEU DONG'. Center-left stands a large black exfoliate bottle beside a purple serum bottle; right side features a female model portrait. Lower left has a large 'SHOPEE DEBUT' badge and lower right has an explosive 'FREESHIP 0D' sticker.
main_subject.style: Polished beauty retail composite with luxury gray backdrop, realistic packshots, and clean editorial model placement

Background is charcoal gray with a soft pale circular spotlight. Surrounding elements: Shopee logo top left, Paula's Choice header, giant headline 'SIEU SALE CUOI THANG QUA TANG NGAP TRAN', a silver rounded offer bar with 'Voucher 1 TRIEU DONG', 'Uu dai 50%', and 'Qua tang 5 TRIEU DONG', orange CTA 'San Ngay tai Shopee', Shopee Debut badge, purple product cartons, and a 'FREESHIP 0D' sticker.
